notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental statement is trimmed p5 (report p10); Total column used. Taxes 354,425 split using the General Fund (p14) and LB 840 (p20) statements; Other 98,318 split into refunds 7,667, lot sales 50, lottery other 3,019, loan repayments 78,822, other 8,760 (GF 27,031 + Econ Dev 46,960 + Lottery 3,019 + LB840 21,308). Transfers 275,776 between General and Economic Development net to zero in the Total column, so transfers_in/out are null; recorded in detail as other financing. Ending cash = ending fund balance 335,143 (includes due from other funds 188,601 and county treasurer 6,853; cash itself is 139,689). Business-type: Combined Utilities Fund, measure net position (statement includes capital assets and debt); beginning 2,835,433 + receipts 2,414,497 - disbursements 2,783,804 + capital contributions 28,189 = ending 2,494,315. Capital contributions (federal grants 28,189) placed in business_type.other_financing. Business-type receipts/disbursements totals are computed (no single printed total). Detail: the all-fund-types budget-and-actual schedule (p12-13) is not recorded for the General, Economic Development, Lottery, LB 840 and utilities funds, which are covered by the more detailed fund schedules (p14-21); its Nursing Home Bonds 27,418 and Airport 13,596 lines (p13), which no other schedule or the governmental funds statement shows, are recorded from it (marked review). The accrual-basis utilities schedule (p22) is an alternate-basis schedule and is not recorded. Cash flow statement (p10-11) not used because basis is cash (proprietary null). Read pages 1-22 of 22
